title: 第23章 不出意外的话第24章 这波我的
content_zh:
“玩得这么绝？”方南山惊讶了，应该不是什么深仇大恨吧，至于这样赶尽杀绝？
“没办法，他们就是这么恶心人，包子明天可能要再推迟登陆时间了，但这样一直躲避也不是办法，对方人多，再换两个人来盯着，包子就没办法发展了。”
这些人先学习了功法，并且升级早，实力强，甚至可以一边在周围杀小骷髅一边盯着包紫燕，如果她走出护罩，他们再过来攻击也来得及，这样对他们的升级影响也不大，倒是小包子可能就要一直被困在护罩里不敢走出去，没办法升级发育，差距会越拉越大。
那只能把登陆时间再往后拖，让对方无法判断，但这样只能有一天的安全发育时间，对方可以在排行榜上查到在线时间，到时还是会派人来针对，那就只有时间不断的延后变化来应对，这样完全打乱自己的生活节奏，现实的修行锻炼也会受到影响。
所以，提前登陆可能会是一个更好的对应。
这就需要服用加速恢复神魂的药剂，此类药剂昂贵无比，一般没有紧急的情况需要提前登陆，都没有人会消耗这些战略物资一样的资源，况且是用在新人身上，更加是巨大的浪费。
方南山暗想，我如果泡出宁神茶，倒是可以给小包子喝一杯，让她快速恢复神魂的消耗，从而能够进行提前登陆的操作，摆脱目前被针对的困境。
但是家里的老树茶叶没有了，买的廉价茶就没出过宁神茶，不过父亲明天应该能从乡下回来，只要中午前能赶回来就行了。
乡下老家跟市里也就二三十公里，现在村村通公路，可以直接开车进去，十分方便，出城一趟也就一两个小时的时间。
“既然这样，那就得跟他们好好玩一下了。”方南山淡淡的敲击着柜台，“居然敢一再的挑衅，他们这是自寻死路。”
“猫哥你有办法？不会是又推迟登陆时间吧？这可不是什么好办法。”
“当然不是，明天自有分晓。”
方南山离开冬梅武馆，往自家小区走去。
小区大门并不远，但回到他家的那栋楼，要绕一个大圈，好像不如走小区的侧门来得便捷，只是侧门那边巷子较为冷清。
方南山看了下街道两旁依然灯火辉煌的热闹店铺，有好几家宵夜的档摊，人气很旺。
从各处武馆陆续有成群结队的武者出来，走向这些大排档。
很平静安宁的城市生活景象，一切都那么和谐。
想了下，他扭身走进一条昏暗的横巷，决定从侧门回去，现在城市的安全状况，还是令人信任的。
穿过并不长的横巷，进入另一条冷清昏暗的街道，前街的人喜欢叫这条屋后的小道为后巷。
后巷另一边是两排树林，树林后面就是小区的围墙，透过树林间隙，可以隐约看到小区的楼房的灯光。

这片树林原本是个小隔离带，后来一些流浪狗流浪猫占据了这块地盘。
前街食店多，后厨的一个厨房垃圾，剩饭剩菜，往往就倒在后巷的垃圾桶里，这里也成为流浪猫狗们的食堂。
大概这些流浪猫狗就是这巷子里最不安全的因素吧。
但现在身体状况已经不同以往的方南山，也不怕普通的猫狗，所以他才大胆的抄近路。
“嗯？这么安静？”
平时在小区里也经常能听到的半夜猫叫狗吠，现在居然一点声息也没有，方南山感觉有些诧异，阴暗的小树林里，似乎气氛有点诡异。
他在各种厨余臭味之中，闻到一股血腥气味。
祖龙凝视！他忽然全身气血一涌，双目骤然一凝，似有一道金光从目中射出，阴暗树林里的景象，竟然一下子清晰了不少。
本来他喝了不少清目茶，视力已经有所提升，练习祖龙凝视这一体式的时候，更有气血奔涌，增加目力的功效，并且两相叠加，让他在这一式的练习进境更快，才第一天锻炼，他就隐约摸到短暂提升目力的诀窍。
树林中的景象让他有点触目惊心，竟然是一地的猫狗尸体，好像大战一场之后的情景。
“啊！巨鼠？”最后入目的场景吓他一跳，竟然是一只体型惊人的巨鼠，它一身乌黑的毛色，在黑夜中几乎难以分辨，但是一双充满了暴戾邪恶凶悍的眼睛，却仿佛射出精光一样，竟是直勾勾的盯着方南山。
它满是利齿的尖嘴咬着一只小猫咪的颈部，血迹从齿间流出，看上去极为凶残可怖。
最令人震撼的是，它体型仿佛大猫，而它嘴里的小猫，却反而像毫无反抗能力的小老鼠。
“这只巨鼠铁定是变异魔鼠，城里居然还有这种凶残的异兽存在，并且就在我的小区旁边？”方南山一时间有些失神，似乎从来没想到会遇上这样的一种情况。
怎么办？
能逃掉吗？
从横巷出去就是前街，那里武者云集，定然是不怕这变异魔鼠的，但就怕速度比不上这魔鼠，没走两步就要被追上，在它这可怕的啮齿下，金属可能都被咬破，况且是血肉之身。
他心跳加速，目光死死盯着魔鼠，精神高度集中，但身体却不敢乱动。
隐约中，他似乎感应到对方急促有力的心脏跳动，以及一股莫名的意识散发。
忽然，巨鼠叼着小猫咪往前走了两步，它速度确实很快，方南山差点捕捉不到它的移动身影。

一瞬间他几乎条件反射般一拳横挡在前，嘴里喝叫一声，“不！”
巨鼠精神剧震，凶残的目光似乎有过一丝迷惑，盯着方南山看了数秒，忽然嘴一松，放下小猫咪，对着他吱吱叫了两声。
方南山精神有点恍惚，好像有一股莫名的意识冲击而来，但又说清是什么，只感觉这巨鼠，没有表现出恶意，他下意识的一挥手，“走开！”
巨鼠竟好像听令一样，迟疑了一下，便转身走了，速度极快，一瞬间就消失在阴暗的小树林中。
content_en:
"Playing so brilliantly?" Fang Nanshan was surprised. It shouldn't be a matter of deep hatred, but killing everyone like this?
"There is no way, they are so disgusting. Baozi may have to postpone the landing time tomorrow, but there is no way to avoid it all the time. There are many people on the other side, and if there are two more people to watch, Baozi will not be able to develop."
These people learned the skills first, upgraded early, and were strong. They could even kill little skeletons around while keeping an eye on Bao Ziyan. If she walked out of the shield, they would have time to come and attack. This would have little impact on their upgrades. However, Baozi might have to be trapped in the shield and dare not go out. Without the ability to upgrade and develop, the gap would widen.
That can only delay the login time further, so that the other party cannot judge, but this only allows one day of safe development time. The other party can check the online time on the ranking list, and will still send people to target it. Then the only way to deal with it is to continuously delay changes in time. This will completely disrupt the rhythm of your life, and your actual practice training will also be affected.
Therefore, logging in early may be a better response.
This requires taking potions that accelerate the recovery of the soul. Such potions are extremely expensive. Generally, unless there is an emergency that requires early landing, no one will consume the same resources as these strategic materials. Moreover, it is a huge waste if they are used on newcomers.
Fang Nanshan thought to himself, if I brew some Ningshen tea, I can give Little Baozi a drink to help her quickly recover from the consumption of her soul, so that she can log in in advance and get out of the current predicament of being targeted.
But the tea leaves from the old trees at home are gone, and the cheap tea we bought has never produced Ningshen tea. However, my father should be able to come back from the countryside tomorrow, as long as he can make it back before noon.
My hometown in the countryside is only 20 to 30 kilometers away from the city. Now every village is connected to a highway and you can drive in directly. It is very convenient. A trip out of the city only takes an hour or two.
"In this case, we have to have some fun with them." Fang Nanshan tapped the counter lightly, "They dare to provoke you again and again. They are asking for death."
"Brother Cat, do you have any idea? It won't delay the login time again, right? This is not a good idea."
"Of course not, we will find out tomorrow."
Fang Nanshan left Dongmei Martial Arts School and walked towards his home community.
The gate of the community is not far away, but to get back to the building where he lives, he has to go around in a big circle. It seems that it is not as convenient as taking the side door of the community, but the alley beyond the side door is deserted.
Fang Nanshan looked at the lively shops on both sides of the street that were still brightly lit. There were several late-night snack stalls that were very popular.
Groups of martial artists came out from various martial arts halls and walked towards these food stalls.
It's a very peaceful and peaceful city life scene, everything is so harmonious.
After thinking for a moment, he turned around and walked into a dark side alley, deciding to go back through the side door. The current security situation in the city was still trustworthy.
Passing through a short side alley, you enter another deserted and dark street. People on the front street like to call this alley behind the houses the back alley.
On the other side of the back alley are two rows of woods. Behind the woods is the wall of the community. Through the gaps between the trees, you can vaguely see the lights of the buildings in the community.
This forest was originally a small isolation zone, but later some stray dogs and cats occupied this territory.
There are many restaurants on the front street, and kitchen waste and leftovers from the back kitchen are often dumped in the trash cans in the back alleys. This area has also become a canteen for stray cats and dogs.
Probably these stray cats and dogs are the most unsafe factor in this alley.
But now that Fang Nanshan's physical condition was different from before, he was not afraid of ordinary cats and dogs, so he boldly took a shortcut.
"Huh? So quiet?"
The cats barking and dogs barking in the middle of the night, which can often be heard in the community, are silent now. Fang Nanshan feels a little surprised. In the dark woods,The atmosphere seemed a bit strange.
Among all the stench of kitchen waste, he smelled the smell of blood.
Zulong stares! Suddenly, blood surged all over his body, and his eyes suddenly condensed. A golden light seemed to shoot out from his eyes, and the scene in the dark woods suddenly became much clearer.
Originally, he drank a lot of eyesight-clearing tea, and his eyesight had improved. When he practiced the Zulong Gaze pose, his blood surged, which increased his eyesight. The two superimposed on each other, making him progress faster in practicing this pose. On the first day of training, he vaguely figured out the secret to temporarily improving his eyesight.
The scene in the woods was a bit shocking to him. It turned out to be the corpses of cats and dogs lying on the ground, as if it was the scene after a great battle.
"Ah! Giant rat?" The last scene he saw shocked him. It turned out to be a giant rat with an astonishing size. It was covered in jet black fur and was almost indistinguishable in the dark night. However, its eyes, full of violence, evil and fierceness, seemed to be shooting out of light, staring straight at Fang Nanshan.
Its sharp mouth full of sharp teeth bit the neck of a kitten, and blood flowed from between the teeth. It looked extremely ferocious and terrifying.
The most shocking thing is that it looks like a big cat, but the kitten in its mouth looks like a little mouse without the ability to resist.
"This giant rat is definitely a mutated demon rat. There is such a ferocious beast in the city, and it is right next to my community?" Fang Nanshan was a little distracted for a moment, as if he had never expected to encounter such a situation.
what to do?
Can you escape?
Going out from the side alley is Qian Street, where warriors gather. They are certainly not afraid of this mutant demon rat, but they are afraid that they cannot match the speed of this demon rat. They will be overtaken in less than two steps. Under its terrifying rodents, the metal may be bitten, not to mention that it is flesh and blood.
His heartbeat quickened, his eyes fixed on the demon rat, and he was highly concentrated, but he did not dare to move his body.
Vaguely, he seemed to sense the rapid and powerful beating of the other party's heart, as well as an inexplicable emanation of consciousness.
Suddenly, the giant rat took two steps forward with the kitten in its mouth. It was really fast, and Fang Nanshan almost couldn't catch its moving figure.
In an instant, almost as a reflex, he punched forward and yelled, "No!"
The giant rat's spirit was greatly shaken. His ferocious eyes seemed to be slightly confused. He stared at Fang Nanshan for a few seconds. Suddenly, he relaxed his mouth, put down the kitten, and squeaked twice at him.
Fang Nanshan was in a daze, as if there was an inexplicable shock to his consciousness, but he couldn't explain what it was. He only felt that the giant rat showed no malice. He waved his hand subconsciously, "Go away!"
The giant rat seemed to obey the order. He hesitated for a moment, then turned and walked away. It was very fast and disappeared into the dark woods in an instant.
